named-query.name: Vehicle.findByPlate
named-query.query: select v from Vehicle v where v.licensePlate = ?1

named-query.name: WorkOrder.findByIds
named-query.query: select w from WorkOrder w where w.id in ?1

named-query.name: WorkOrder.findNotInvoicedByClientNif
named-query.query: select w from WorkOrder w where w.vehicle.client.nif = ?1 and w.state = uo.ri.cws.domain.WorkOrder.WorkOrderState.APPROVED

named-query.name: PaymentMean.findByInvoiceId
named-query.query: select m from Invoice f join f.workOrders w join w.vehicle.client c join c.paymentMeans m where f.id = ?1

named-query.name: PaymentMean.findByClientNif
named-query.query: select pm from PaymentMean pm where pm.client.nif = ?1

named-query.name: PaymentMean.findVouchersByClientNif
named-query.query: select v from Voucher v where v.client.nif = ?1

named-query.name: PaymentMean.findVoucherByCode
named-query.query: select v from Voucher v where v.code = ?1

named-query.name: PaymentMean.findCreditCardByNumber
named-query.query: select c from CreditCard c where c.number = ?1

named-query.name: PaymentMean.findByIds
named-query.query: select pm from PaymentMean pm where pm.id in ?1

named-query.name: PaymentMean.countCharges
named-query.query: select count(c) from Charge c where c.paymentMean.id = ?1

named-query.name: Voucher.summary
named-query.query: select v.client.nif.nif, v.client.fullName.name, v.client.fullName.surname, count(v), sum(v.accumulated.amount), sum(v.availableAmount.amount) from Voucher v group by v.client.nif.nif, v.client.fullName.name, v.client.fullName.surname order by sum(v.availableAmount.amount) desc

named-query.name: Mechanic.findByNif
named-query.query: select m from Mechanic m where m.nif = ?1

named-query.name: Mechanic.countInterventions
named-query.query: select count(i) from Intervention i where i.mechanic.id = ?1

named-query.name: Invoice.findByNumber
named-query.query: select f from Invoice f where f.number = ?1

named-query.name: Invoice.findOverAmountUnusedForVoucher
named-query.query: select i from Invoice i where i.total.amount > ?1 and i.usedForVoucher = false and i.state = uo.ri.cws.domain.Invoice.InvoiceState.PAID

named-query.name: Invoice.getNextInvoiceNumber
named-query.query: select cast( coalesce(max(f.number) + 1, 1L) as bigint ) from Invoice f

named-query.name: Client.findByNif
named-query.query: select c from Client c where c.nif = ?1

named-query.name: Client.findRecommendedBy
named-query.query: select r.recommended from Recommendation r where r.recommender.nif = ?1

named-query.name: Client.findWithWorkOrdersUnusedForVoucher
named-query.query: select distinct c from Client c join c.vehicles v join v.workOrders wo where wo.usedForVoucher = false and wo.state = uo.ri.cws.domain.WorkOrder.WorkOrderState.INVOICED group by c having count(wo) >= ?1

named-query.name: Client.findWithRecommendationsUnusedForVoucher
named-query.query: select distinct c from Client c join c.recommendations r where r.usedForVoucher = false group by c having count(r) >= ?1

named-query.name: Client.hasPaidInvoices
named-query.query: select count(distinct i) from Invoice i join i.workOrders wo join wo.vehicle v join v.client c where c.id = ?1 and i.state = uo.ri.cws.domain.Invoice.InvoiceState.PAID
